folder_html:
LIVE AIR TEMPERATURE

Near-surface (2 m) air temperature from the operational HRRR analysis. Banded 5-degree key (-60..150 F): blue-white extreme cold, gray-blue subfreezing, royal-blue freezing wall (30-40), frigid turquoise/blues (40-55), lime/teal transition (55-70), mellow yellows (70-85), orange/gold warming (85-100), scorching pink/reds past 100. Every band brightened so nothing renders dark.

2 m air temperature (degF), FIXED key (-60..150 F) with a STEADY gradient on the map: the raster blends smoothly through blue-white extreme cold → gray-blue subfreezing → royal-blue freezing wall (30-40) → frigid turquoise/blues (40-55) → transitional lime/teals (55-70) → mellow yellows (70-85) → warming orange/golds (85-100) → scorching pink/reds (100+) to HIGHEST+ 150, passing exactly through every key color (key bars show the LOWEST -60 to HIGHEST+ 150 band centers). Same temperature always shows the same color; every color is brightened so nothing renders dark. Freezing (32 F) sits inside the royal-blue wall. Record LOWEST 26.02 / HIGHEST+ 89.09.
